component.name: Orbit Simulator
component.summary: Find your way around the solar system with real orbital physics

description.p: Orbit Simulator is a game for building an intuition for orbital mechanics. You're somewhere in the solar system with a tank of fuel: plan burns, watch where they take you, and get where you're going. The Sun and every planet pull on you all the way.

ul.li: Get home from between the planets, the asteroid belt or orbit around Jupiter
Leave a low orbit around the Earth for any planet: reach it, fly past it, or orbit it
Gravity assists: aim a pass by a planet and see what it gives you
Hints that plan the way when you're stuck
